name: amomic-ai-docs
description: Search the Amomic-AI documentation and REST API reference from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Amomic-AI Docs answers questions about building on Amomic-AI, the AI support platform for voice calls, WhatsApp and web chat. It searches the complete public documentation at docs.amomic.in and the published REST API contract, reads the matching page, and answers with links to the source.

Use it to set up a WhatsApp number or voice agent, configure knowledge sources, run campaigns, handle webhooks and signatures, or find the exact method, path and response codes for an API endpoint.

It is intended for developers and operators evaluating or integrating Amomic-AI. It only reads public documentation: it does not need an account, cannot see or change any Amomic-AI workspace, and cannot send messages or place calls.
defaultPrompt: How do I connect a WhatsApp number to Amomic-AI?
Which Amomic-AI API endpoint sends a message?
How do I verify Amomic-AI webhook signatures?

positive.description: Set-up question answered from the docs
positive.prompt: How do I connect a WhatsApp number to Amomic-AI?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Set up WhatsApp' page and explains the connection steps, with a link to docs.amomic.in/channels/whatsapp.

positive.prompt: Which Amomic-AI API endpoint sends a message, and what does it return?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns POST /api/v1/messages with its 201 and 422 responses, without inventing other endpoints.

positive.prompt: How do I verify Amomic-AI webhook signatures, and what status should I return when verification fails?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the 'Verifying signatures' page, including the recommended status code, with a link to docs.amomic.in/webhooks/signatures.

positive.prompt: Open the Amomic-AI quickstart and list its steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the quickstart page and lists its steps in order, citing the page URL.

positive.prompt: What voice languages does Amomic-AI support for phone calls?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the voice languages page and links to it, without adding languages that are not listed there.

negative.description: Account action outside a read-only docs plugin
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +91 98765 43210 from my Amomic-AI account.

negative.description: Private workspace data the plugin cannot access
negative.prompt: Show me yesterday's call recordings from my Amomic-AI workspace.
Book me a flight from Delhi to Mumbai tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: This plugin only reads public documentation. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the Amomic-AI documentation, read pages, and look up REST API endpoints.
